lines: Hail Īśa, who speeds each human aim to harvest —
bow-worthy, yea, the very bow — whose, here, of the steady?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām

c1_essence: Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
